representation.plain_text: Goal Statement GS, Constraint List C, Knowledge Graph KG, Critic LLMs: [C1, C2, C3] Hypotheses Generator HG, Summarizer S Number of Cycles max_cycles = 5 HH ← [] // Hypothesis History initialized as empty list FAC ← [] // Feedback from all critics initialized as empty list Generate Initial Hypothesis: V h ← HG(GS, C, KG) HH .append(V h ) if all V h agreed by C1, C2, C3 then return V h end else for cycle = 1 to max_cycles do FAC ← f eedback(GS, C, HH [-1]) // Feedback from all critics SF ← summariser(FAC ) // Summarized Feedback from all critics R h ← HG(GS, C, KG, HH [-1] , SF ) // Refined Hypothesis HH .append(R h ) AS ← intersection(FAC ) // Agreed Suggestions if len(AS) == 20 then break end end end return HH [-1]
